decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch, this system is still early in its commercialization and the firm is likely to continue it to justify recent development effort, even though the website commitment appears only moderate.
Because the pump has its own webpage, the firm has made a visible public commitment and is therefore likely to persist with it after only one year on the market.

This product has lower visible commitment than products with dedicated pages, but as a recent launch in a medium-sized German machinery firm it is still likely to be retained while management attributes any weak uptake to temporary market factors.
The dedicated webpage signals strong commitment and strategic intent, making management unlikely to withdraw it so soon after launch despite any early uncertainty.
